data.title: When will Real Madrid players be in action during this international break?
data.content:
Ben Gray

Few clubs in world football will have more players in action during this international break than Real Madrid. In total, 15 members of José Mourinho's squad are set to be in senior action for their countries around the world. So, find out who will be in action and when.

## Spain: Marc Cucurella and Dean Huijsen

Fixtures: 12 November vs Czechia and 15 November vs England. [...] Spain are seeking to continue their streak of 11 successive victories, aiming to reach a fourth UEFA Nations League Final in a row. Marc Cucurella is Luis de la Fuente's first-choice left-back, while Dean Huijsen is back in the fold, having featured in only one of four fixtures during the last international window.

## Brazil: Vinícius Júnior and Endrick

Fixtures: 14 November vs Japan and 17 November vs Singapore. [...] In the act of scoring the only goal in İzmit in September, Kylian Mbappé suffered a hamstring injury, thereby curtailing his international window early. He will though be a key player for Zinédine Zidane, with Ibrahima Konaté and Eduardo Camavinga also in les Bleus' squad, but Aurélien Tchouaméni is not, withdrawing due to an abductor injury on Wednesday.

## England: Jude Bellingham and Trent Alexander-Arnold

Fixtures: 12 November vs Croatia and 15 November vs Spain.
